# Repo Deputy

> Repo Deputy is a whole-repository drift scanner that audits public GitHub repositories for duplication, architectural drift, circular dependencies, complexity, and stale documentation, then deputizes a pull request to clean it up.

- Canonical: https://repo-deputy.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/frostney/repo-deputy

## What it does

It scans public GitHub repositories for duplication, architectural drift, circular dependencies, complexity, and stale documentation, then deputizes a pull request to clean it up.

Surfaces: a public dashboard and a local stdio MCP server for agent workflows.

## What this is not

This is a whole-repository drift scanner. It is not a generic chat coding assistant.
